title: Solana market-data provenance and conflict-contract design
objective: Produce an auditable Solana-only design for append-only market observations, provider trust separation, conflict handling and candidate-pool polling without implementing a provider or asserting unverified third-party API capability.
forbidden_actions: Do not modify source, migrations, tests, fixtures, task ledger or task specifications.
Do not call network APIs, use provider credentials or retain raw provider payloads.
Do not activate BSC or Robinhood, production webhooks, database backfills or external providers.
Do not present unverified third-party API behavior or labels as chain facts.
